arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)' AND t.amount_usd_cents > 50000
arguments.explanation: Counts the transactions above $500 made with prepaid debit cards, across the whole data period.
assumptions: Prepaid debit cards means card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)' only, not 'Debit'.
Over $500 means strictly more than 50000 cents. Negative amounts are left out.
Covers every transaction in the data (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31), whether or not it has a fraud label.
